notes.title: SteamVR Patches | YUR VERSION 2.3.3 CHANGELOG
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the latest SteamVR that caused devices other than the headset going into standby to pause tracking
[*] When used in conjunction with things that set tags (such as song name in beat saber), tags will now record properly
[*] Bug fixed where the overlay being disabled would prevent information from updating in the beat saber mod
[*] Fixed a bug with the latest SteamVR that prevented WMR headsets from coming out of standby when starting up
[/list]

notes.title: Share a Day's Progress | YUR VERSION 2.3.1 CHANGELOG
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Oculus app tracking significantly improved
[*] Many issues addressed to prevent workouts being lost if internet connectivity drops or the system hangs
[*] You now have the option to share a day's progress on Facebook or Twitter from within the app or from https://app.yur.fit
[*] Updated predictive heart rate model which will increase accuracy for wider a range of body types
[*] "Background" calories should count significantly less when you're low activity and not moving much
[*] Predictive heart rate will show as blue now, actual heart rate (when paired with a Bluetooth heart rate monitor) will show in red to make it more obvious
[*] Improvements to detecting when a headset goes idle or into standby mode to stop tracking calories
[*] Overall performance improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Machine Learning kcal Algorithm | YUR VERSION 2.2.4 CHANGELOG
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Machine learning calorie calculation algorithm
[*] Heart rate prediction
[*] Burn rate (in kcal/min) displayed and charted on overlay
[*] Activity levels corresponding to predicted heart rate zones:[list][*] Low Activity (Gray) < 60% max heart rate
[*] Light Activity (Green) 60-70%
[*] Moderate Activity (Blue) 71-80%
[*] Intense Activity (Purple) 81-90%
[*] Vigorous Activity (Orange) 91%+
[/list][*] Improved native oculus app tracking
[*] Dashboard, steam VR home, and other "launcher" apps no longer record calories until a game is started
[/list]

notes.title: AMD GPUs are now supported for the overlay | YUR VERSION 2.2.2 CHANGELOG
notes.content:
[list]
[*] AMD GPUs are now supported for the overlay and steam dashboard
[*] Laptops with dual GPUs (e.g. Intel and Nvidia) work more consistently
[*] Improved steam dashboard performance
[*] Dashboard now reloads data instead of refreshing the entire page (double click the YUR.fit icon to force a reload)
[*] Improved load time on the YUR dashboard and desktop app
[*] Google login should now work by using a device code mechanism
[/list] 

Join our community @ [url=https://yur.chat]yur.chat[/url] for more info and support. Thank you.
